rice.name: Rice (Paddy / Dhan)
limitations: Heavy groundwater extraction in dry season
Puddled soil forms dense plow pan
High methane emissions under continuous flooding
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

wheat.name: Wheat (Gehun)
limitations: Highly sensitive to terminal heat stress during grain filling in March
Requires 4-5 timely irrigations
Zero N fixation
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

maize.name: Maize (Corn / Makka)
limitations: Heavy nutrient extractor; requires balanced NPK
Susceptible to Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda)
Waterlogging sensitive in early stage
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

pearl_millet.name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
limitations: Lower grain price realization compared to MSP cereals in eastern states
Cannot tolerate waterlogging
Susceptible to downy mildew
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

sorghum.name: Sorghum (Jowar)
limitations: Susceptible to shoot fly and stem borer
Allelopathic root exudates can slightly suppress succeeding pulse emergence if not tilled
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

finger_millet.name: Finger Millet (Ragi / Mandua)
limitations: Slow early vegetative growth requiring careful weed control
Threshing and processing machinery less widespread in north India
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

foxtail_millet.name: Foxtail Millet (Kangni / Kakum)

Niche local market demand
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

barley.name: Barley (Jau)

Requires premium malting grade varieties for industrial brewery contracts
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

chickpea.name: Chickpea (Gram / Chana)
limitations: Highly sensitive to waterlogging and collar rot
Susceptible to pod borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

pigeonpea.name: Pigeonpea (Arhar / Tur)
limitations: Long duration ties up land into late Rabi unless early varieties (UPAS-120) are used
Sterility mosaic disease risk
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

lentil.name: Lentil (Masoor)
limitations: Susceptible to Stemphylium blight and vascular wilt during warm winter transitions
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

green_gram.name: Green Gram (Moong)

Pod shattering if harvesting is delayed
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

black_gram.name: Black Gram (Urad)
limitations: Susceptible to powdery mildew and Cercospora leaf spot in humid conditions
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

field_pea.name: Field Pea (Matar)
limitations: Powdery mildew (Erysiphe pisi) during warm February days
Frost vulnerability during flowering
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

cowpea.name: Cowpea (Lobia)
cowpea.data_source: TNAU Agritech Portal & ICAR Pulse Guide
limitations: Aphid infestation vectors mosaic virus
Excessive vegetative growth if over-irrigated
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

soybean.name: Soybean
limitations: Seed viability deteriorates rapidly under high humidity in eastern India
Girdle beetle damage
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

cluster_bean.name: Cluster Bean (Guar)
cluster_bean.data_source: ICAR-CAZRI Jodhpur Guar Package of Practices
limitations: Highly sensitive to waterlogging
Bacterial blight in humid monsoon zones
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

horse_gram.name: Horse Gram (Kulthi)
horse_gram.data_source: ICAR Pulses Manual & BAU Sabour Tribal Sub-Plan
limitations: Low harvest index and lower yield potential than chickpea or lentil
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

mustard.name: Mustard / Rapeseed (Sarson / Rai)
limitations: Mustard aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) attack during cloudy/humid spells
Frost sensitivity during siliqua filling
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Brassicaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

groundnut.name: Groundnut / Peanut (Moongphali)
limitations: Requires light friable soil for peg penetration and easy pod harvesting
Aflatoxin risk in wet storage
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

sesame.name: Sesame (Til)
limitations: Extremely vulnerable to water stagnation even for 24 hours
Phyllody disease transmitted by leafhoppers
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Pedaliaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

sunflower.name: Sunflower (Surajmukhi)
limitations: Bird damage (parrots) near harvest
Requires managed bee pollination for optimal seed set
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Asteraceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

safflower.name: Safflower (Kusum)
limitations: Spiny foliage makes manual harvesting difficult
Aphids during budding
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Asteraceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

linseed.name: Linseed / Flax (Alsi)
limitations: Often grown as utera/paira crop with low management leading to modest yields
Rust vulnerability
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Linaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

castor.name: Castor (Arandi)
limitations: Non-edible toxic oil (ricin in seeds)
Long duration precludes immediate Rabi sowing on same plot
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Euphorbiaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

potato.name: Potato (Aloo)
limitations: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans) epidemics under cold humid spells
Heavy input costs for seed tubers and cold storage
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Solanaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

onion.name: Onion (Pyaz)
limitations: High post-harvest storage loss (up to 30% rotting)
Extreme price volatility across seasons
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Amaryllidaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

tomato.name: Tomato (Tamatar)
limitations: Tomato leaf curl virus (ToLCV) via whitefly
Market price collapse during peak glut
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Solanaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

brinjal.name: Brinjal / Eggplant (Baingan)
limitations: Shoot and fruit borer (Leucinodes orbonalis) requires intensive IPM
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Solanaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

cauliflower.name: Cauliflower (Phool Gobhi)
limitations: Buttoning and riciness if temperatures fluctuate during curd initiation
Diamondback moth
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Brassicaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

cabbage.name: Cabbage (Patta Gobhi)
limitations: Black rot (Xanthomonas) in rainy transitions
Diamondback moth infestation
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Brassicaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

okra.name: Okra / Ladyfinger (Bhindi)
limitations: Yellow Vein Mosaic Virus (YVMV) requires resistant hybrids
Requires picking every 2-3 days
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Malvaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

green_chilli.name: Green Chilli (Mirchi)
limitations: Chilli leaf curl and thrips/mites complex
Water stagnation causes sudden wilt
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Solanaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

garlic.name: Garlic (Lahsun)
limitations: Bulb rot in poorly drained soil
High initial seed clove purchase cost
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Amaryllidaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

ginger.name: Ginger (Adrak)
limitations: Rhizome rot (Pythium) under excessive moisture
Requires partial shade and mulch
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Zingiberaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

carrot.name: Carrot (Gajar)
limitations: Forking and splitting in heavy or compact clay soils
Cavity spot in wet beds
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Apiaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

radish.name: Radish (Mooli)
limitations: Pithiness and pungency if harvest delayed past 55 days
Flea beetle damage
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Brassicaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

bitter_gourd.name: Bitter Gourd (Karela)
limitations: Fruit fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae) requires pheromone traps
Downy mildew in rainy season
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Cucurbitaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane (Ganna)
limitations: Extreme water demand (~1800 mm)
Ties up land for 10-12 months
Mill payment settlement delays
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Poaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

cotton.name: Cotton (Kapas)
limitations: Pink bollworm resistance challenges
Not traditionally suited to heavy flood-prone eastern plains
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Malvaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

jute.name: Jute (Patson)
limitations: Requires abundant clean slow-moving water bodies for microbial retting
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Malvaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

tobacco.name: Tobacco (Tambaku)
limitations: Heavy chemical input requirements
Strict curing barn infrastructure needed
Soil health depleting
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Solanaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

betel_vine.name: Betel Vine (Paan)
limitations: Requires specialized thatched conservatories (bareja)
High labor and constant disease monitoring
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Piperaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

banana.name: Banana (Kela)
limitations: High continuous water demand
Panama wilt (Fusarium oxysporum) and bunchy top virus
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Musaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

papaya.name: Papaya (Papita)
limitations: Cannot tolerate even 12 hours of waterlogging (causes stem rot)
Papaya ring spot virus (PRSV)
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Caricaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

guava.name: Guava (Amrud)
limitations: Guava wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. psidii) in alkaline soils
Fruit fly during rainy season crop
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Myrtaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

mango.name: Mango (Aam)
mango.data_source: ICAR-CISH Lucknow & BAU Sabour Mango Guide
limitations: Alternate bearing habit in traditional cultivars
Mango malformation and hopper pests
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Anacardiaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

pomegranate.name: Pomegranate (Anar)
limitations: Bacterial blight (Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. punicae) can wipe out orchards
Sensitive to fruit cracking under erratic moisture
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Lythraceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

turmeric.name: Turmeric (Haldi)
limitations: Long 8-month field occupancy
Rhizome rot and leaf blotch in waterlogged soils
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Zingiberaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

cumin.name: Cumin (Jeera)
limitations: Requires very dry cool climate during flowering
High humidity causes devastating blight (Alternaria burnsii)
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Apiaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

coriander.name: Coriander (Dhania)
limitations: Powdery mildew and stem gall disease under humid mornings
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Apiaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

fenugreek.name: Fenugreek (Methi)
limitations: Downy and powdery mildew in poorly aerated dense stands
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Fabaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

fennel.name: Fennel (Saunf)
limitations: Ramularia blight during cloudy humid weather at flowering
Long duration extends into April
rotation_restrictions: Avoid repeating Apiaceae species back-to-back to prevent pathogen accumulation.

hard_red_winter_wheat.name: Hard Red Winter Wheat
hard_red_winter_wheat.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Requires vernalization (cold period) to induce flowering.
Susceptible to stripe rust (Puccinia striiformis).
rotation_restrictions: Rotate with broadleaf crops; avoid back-to-back wheat.

hard_red_spring_wheat.name: Hard Red Spring Wheat
hard_red_spring_wheat.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: High protein grain; vulnerable to early summer heat stress during anthesis.
rotation_restrictions: Avoid continuous cereal cropping to suppress root diseases.

soft_red_winter_wheat.name: Soft Red Winter Wheat
soft_red_winter_wheat.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Lower protein flour suited for pastries; susceptible to head scab in humid springs.
rotation_restrictions: Do not follow corn directly if fusarium pressure is severe.

durum_wheat.name: Durum / Pasta Wheat
durum_wheat.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Hard vitreous grain; highly sensitive to waterlogging; demands warm dry ripening period.
rotation_restrictions: Follow with chickpea or faba bean for nitrogen synergy.

spelt.name: Spelt (Dinkel Wheat)
spelt.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Retains protective husk requiring dehulling; excels on marginal lower-fertility soils.
rotation_restrictions: Tolerates poorer preceding soil fertility.

emmer.name: Emmer Wheat (Khapli)
emmer.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Low glycemic index; resistant to stem and leaf rusts; hulls require mechanical processing.
rotation_restrictions: Excellent rust break crop compared to common bread wheat.

einkorn.name: Einkorn Wheat
einkorn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Diplod ancient grain; extremely low nutrient demand; thick hull protects against weathering.
rotation_restrictions: Performs reliably on poor shallow soils where modern wheats fail.

khorasan_wheat.name: Khorasan Wheat (Kamut)
khorasan_wheat.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Large amber grain with rich buttery flavor; demands low humidity ripening.
rotation_restrictions: Avoid humid climates with persistent rainfall during flowering.

rye_winter.name: Winter Rye
rye_winter.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Most cold-tolerant winter cereal (-30C); exceptional root biomass; strong allelopathic weed suppression.
rotation_restrictions: Heavy straw residues require careful nitrogen management for following crop.

spring_rye.name: Spring Rye
spring_rye.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Rapid maturity in northern short growing seasons; thrives where wheat fails due to soil acidity.
rotation_restrictions: Allelopathic root exudates suppress weeds naturally.

triticale_winter.name: Winter Triticale
triticale_winter.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Wheat yield potential combined with rye hardiness; superior biomass and drought resilience.
rotation_restrictions: Double-crop as silage or grain harvest before summer annuals.

triticale_spring.name: Spring Triticale
triticale_spring.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Fast biomass producer; excellent livestock feed grain with high lysine content.
rotation_restrictions: Rotate with nitrogen-fixing pulse crops.

two_row_barley.name: Two-Row Malting Barley
two_row_barley.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Uniform plump kernels; requires strictly regulated N to keep grain protein between 9.5-11.5%.
rotation_restrictions: Avoid high soil residual nitrogen preceding malting barley.

six_row_barley.name: Six-Row Feed Barley
six_row_barley.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: High enzyme power; superior salinity and drought tolerance over bread wheat.
rotation_restrictions: Excellent short-window catch crop after late kharif harvest.

hulless_barley.name: Hulless Barley (Naked Barley)
hulless_barley.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Threshes cleanly without hull; staple in Himalayan highlands (Tsampa); rich in beta-glucan.
rotation_restrictions: Direct food grade grain; avoids costly abrasive dehulling machinery.

oats_common.name: Common White Oat
oats_common.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Rich in heart-healthy beta-glucans; excellent cool-season grain and dual-purpose green fodder.
rotation_restrictions: Take-all root rot break crop for continuous wheat systems.

black_oats.name: Black Oat (Bristle Oat)
black_oats.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Key cover crop in Brazilian Cerrado no-till systems; suppresses root-knot nematodes.
rotation_restrictions: Incredible biomass producer and mycorrhizal soil inoculant.

hulless_oat.name: Naked Oat (Hulless Oat)
hulless_oat.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Grain threshes free of fibrous hull; extraordinarily high groat energy and lipids.
rotation_restrictions: Store carefully as exposed groat oil can turn rancid faster if bruised.

basmati_rice.name: Basmati Aromatic Rice
basmati_rice.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Geographical Indication protected long grain aromatic rice; commands export price premium.
rotation_restrictions: Puddling alters soil aggregation; follow with deep taprooted pulses to break hardpan.

japonica_rice.name: Japonica Short Grain Rice
japonica_rice.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Short plump grain with high amylopectin content; cold tolerant during vegetative stage.
rotation_restrictions: Rotate with winter wheat, barley or legume cover in rice-barley basins.

upland_rice.name: Upland Aerobic Rice
upland_rice.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Grown in unflooded non-puddled soil like wheat or maize; slashes water demand by 50%.
rotation_restrictions: High weed susceptibility requires early canopy shading or mulching.

deepwater_rice.name: Deepwater Floating Rice
deepwater_rice.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Internodes elongate rapidly (up to 25 cm/day) with rising floodwaters up to 4 meters deep.
rotation_restrictions: Ideal for seasonally submerged floodplains where no other crop survives.

black_rice.name: Black Forbidden Rice (Chak-hao)
black_rice.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Pericarp intensely pigmented with anthocyanin antioxidants; prized superfood market.
rotation_restrictions: Harvest carefully to avoid grain shattering loss.

red_cargo_rice.name: Red Cargo Rice (Navara)
red_cargo_rice.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Ayurvedic medicinal rice rich in iron, zinc, and polyphenols; short duration ecotypes.
rotation_restrictions: Traditional heritage variety requiring organic nutrient inputs.

wild_rice_northern.name: Northern Wild Rice
wild_rice_northern.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Aquatic marsh grass native to Great Lakes; high protein, nutty flavor gourmet grain.
rotation_restrictions: Cultivated in flooded paddies with precise water level management.

proso_millet.name: Proso Millet (Cheena)
proso_millet.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Lowest water requirement of any cereal; fastest maturing cereal grain (60-70 days); perfect catch crop.
rotation_restrictions: Exceptional emergency catch crop between rabi harvest and kharif planting.

kodo_millet.name: Kodo Millet (Kodon)
kodo_millet.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Toughest coarse grain; survives extreme drought on shallow skeletal soils; high dietary fiber and polyphenol content.
rotation_restrictions: Can be stored for up to 30 years without insect damage.

barnyard_millet.name: Barnyard Millet (Sanwa)
barnyard_millet.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Richest in digestible iron (18 mg/100g); fastest growing millet under cool mountain conditions.
rotation_restrictions: Excellent catch crop in contingent drought plans.

little_millet.name: Little Millet (Kutki)
little_millet.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Endures prolonged dry spells followed by sudden heavy rain; high iron and antioxidant content.
rotation_restrictions: Ideal for tribal and rainfed dryland farming systems.

browntop_millet.name: Browntop Millet (Korale)
browntop_millet.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: High market price; exceptional for lead/toxic metal remediation and wildlife cover; thrives in poor soils.
rotation_restrictions: Quick canopy provides early soil erosion protection.

teff_brown.name: Brown Teff
teff_brown.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Tiny grain packed with iron and calcium; gluten-free; adapts to both drought and waterlogged black clays.
rotation_restrictions: Tiny seeds need firm, shallow seedbed preparation.

teff_white.name: White Teff (Ivory Teff)
teff_white.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Prestige food grain for injera flatbread; highest commercial value among teff market classes.
rotation_restrictions: Higher fertility response than brown teff.

fonio_white.name: White Fonio (Acha)
fonio_white.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Matures in as little as 60-70 days; rescues Sahelian farmers during the hunger gap before main harvest.
rotation_restrictions: Thrives in poor, infertile sandy soils where other grains starve.

fonio_black.name: Black Fonio (Iburu)
fonio_black.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Longer duration West African grain; richer in sulfur-containing amino acids (methionine and cystine).
rotation_restrictions: Valuable regional food security crop.

quinoa_white.name: White Quinoa
quinoa_white.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Complete protein with all 9 essential amino acids; extraordinary salinity and frost tolerance; saponin coat protects grain.
rotation_restrictions: Requires dry cool weather during seed ripening; wash saponins before processing.

quinoa_red.name: Red Quinoa (Pasankalla)
quinoa_red.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: High anthocyanin pigment; holds structure exceptionally well in culinary cooking.
rotation_restrictions: Thrives in high solar radiation environments.

quinoa_black.name: Black Quinoa
quinoa_black.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Earthy rich flavor; longest maturation among quinoa cultivars; highest antioxidant capacity.
rotation_restrictions: Harvest when seed heads are fully cured.

canihua.name: Cañihua (Kaniwa)
canihua.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Survives extreme Altiplano frost down to -10C; saponin-free seed requires no scrubbing.
rotation_restrictions: Super-resilient high-altitude cold-tolerant grain.

amaranth_grain_cruentus.name: Grain Amaranth (Cruentus)
amaranth_grain_cruentus.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: C4 photosynthetic efficiency; rich in squalene and lysine; thrives under heat and water deficit.
rotation_restrictions: Tiny seed requires shallow sowing into warm soil.

amaranth_grain_caudatus.name: Grain Amaranth (Love-Lies-Bleeding)
amaranth_grain_caudatus.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Long pendulous grain heads; revered staple of the Inca civilization; high dietary minerals.
rotation_restrictions: Provides excellent soil shading once canopy closes.

buckwheat_common.name: Common Buckwheat
buckwheat_common.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Extremely rapid growth (65-75 days); scours insoluble rock phosphorus from soil; premier pollinator magnet.
rotation_restrictions: Sensitive to frost and extreme heat (>35C) during flowering causing blossom blast.

buckwheat_tartary.name: Tartary Buckwheat (Bitter Buckwheat)
buckwheat_tartary.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: 100x higher rutin content than common buckwheat; remarkable frost tolerance in high alpine plateaus.
rotation_restrictions: Self-pollinating; more stable yields under cool cloudy weather.

chia_seed_grain.name: Chia Grain
chia_seed_grain.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Richest plant source of alpha-linolenic omega-3 fatty acids; hydrophilic mucilage aids digestion.
rotation_restrictions: Short-day flowering response; unseasonal early autumn frost can terminate seed set.

jobs_tears.name: Job's Tears (Adlay / Coix)
jobs_tears.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: High protein grain; renowned in Asian medicine for anti-inflammatory properties; hard bead-like shell.
rotation_restrictions: Tolerates saturated soils and seasonal waterlogging far better than maize.

dent_corn.name: Yellow Dent Field Corn
dent_corn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Workhorse of global livestock feed and ethanol production; high starch yield; heavy nitrogen feeder.
rotation_restrictions: Rotate systematically with soybean to interrupt corn rootworm cycle.

flint_corn.name: Flint Corn (Indian Corn)
flint_corn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Hard vitreous endosperm resistant to weevil damage; superior cold-soil germination.
rotation_restrictions: Ideal for polenta and masa harina production.

popcorn.name: Popcorn Maize
popcorn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Hard pericarp with moisture-sealed endosperm (13.5-14% optimum popping moisture).
rotation_restrictions: Isolate from dent corn by 250m to prevent xenia cross-pollination degrading pop quality.

sweet_corn.name: Sweet Corn (Sugar Corn)
sweet_corn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Recessive su, se, or sh2 genes prevent conversion of sugar to starch; fresh harvest at milk stage.
rotation_restrictions: Harvest within tight 3-5 day window for peak brix sweetness.

waxy_corn.name: Waxy Maize
waxy_corn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: 100% amylopectin starch; widely grown in China and Southeast Asia for sticky steamed cobs.
rotation_restrictions: Maintain isolation from non-waxy corn cultivars.

blue_corn.name: Hopi Blue Maize
blue_corn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Deep anthocyanin pigment; extensive root foraging developed for dryland desert farming.
rotation_restrictions: Specialty culinary value for artisanal tortilla chips and blue masa.

sweet_sorghum.name: Sweet Sorghum (Sorgho)
sweet_sorghum.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Stalks accumulate up to 18-22% fermentable sugars; dual-purpose bioethanol and grain crop.
rotation_restrictions: Harvest at soft-dough stage for maximum juice extraction and sugar purity.

broomcorn.name: Broomcorn Sorghum
broomcorn.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Long stiff panicle branches traditionally harvested for high-grade natural household brooms.
rotation_restrictions: Cut panicles while still pliable and green before seeds fully mature.

red_lentil.name: Red Lentil (Crimson Masoor)
red_lentil.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Highly sensitive to waterlogging and collar rot during early vegetative stages.
rotation_restrictions: Rotate with cereals; avoid continuous pulse cultivation.

green_lentil.name: French Green Lentil (Puy)
green_lentil.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Holds shape well when cooked; highly valued in European gourmet culinary markets.
rotation_restrictions: Requires dry sunny harvest conditions to prevent seed staining.

brown_lentil.name: Brown Lentil (Spanish Pardina)
brown_lentil.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Mild earthy flavor; versatile all-purpose cooking pulse.
rotation_restrictions: Do not follow legumes within 3 years in rotation.

black_beluga_lentil.name: Black Beluga Lentil
black_beluga_lentil.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Tiny glossy black seeds resembling caviar; rich in anthocyanins; premium pricing.
rotation_restrictions: Requires clean weed-free seedbed due to slow early canopy closure.

desi_chickpea.name: Desi Chickpea (Bengal Gram)
desi_chickpea.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Small angular dark seeds; excellent drought hardiness; high dehulling milling recovery.
rotation_restrictions: Avoid waterlogged soils; strictly avoid solanaceous preceding crops where wilt is endemic.

kabuli_chickpea.name: Kabuli Chickpea (Garbanzo)
kabuli_chickpea.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Large creamy seeds; thinner seed coat makes seed more prone to soil-borne damping off.
rotation_restrictions: Seed treatment with fungicide and Rhizobium inoculant is essential.

green_chickpea.name: Green Chickpea (Hara Chana)
green_chickpea.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Harvested tender at immature green pod stage for fresh gourmet consumption.
rotation_restrictions: Short field duration allows flexible double cropping.

yellow_field_pea.name: Yellow Field Pea
yellow_field_pea.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Dominant ingredient for plant-based protein isolates; leaves generous nitrogen credit for following cereals.
rotation_restrictions: Avoid soils prone to crusting; maintain 4-year rotation interval against aphanomyces root rot.

green_field_pea.name: Green Field Pea
green_field_pea.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Used for split pea soups and pet feeds; bleached kernels penalized heavily at elevator.
rotation_restrictions: Harvest prompt at 16-18% moisture to prevent sun bleaching.

austrian_winter_pea.name: Austrian Winter Pea
austrian_winter_pea.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Cold-hardy winter cover legume; fixes massive quantities of nitrogen (up to 120 kg/ha); vigorous spring vine growth.
rotation_restrictions: Terminate mechanically with roller-crimper before seed set.

pinto_bean.name: Pinto Dry Bean
pinto_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Most widely produced edible dry bean in North America; beige seed with reddish-brown speckles.
rotation_restrictions: Requires warm well-aerated soils; highly sensitive to zinc deficiency and waterlogging.

black_turtle_bean.name: Black Turtle Bean
black_turtle_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Staple of Latin American and Caribbean cuisines; rich meaty texture and dense anthocyanin hull.
rotation_restrictions: Avoid dense canopies in high-humidity zones to reduce white mold.

navy_bean.name: Navy Bean (Haricot / White Pea Bean)
navy_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Small white oval bean utilized for commercial canned baked beans.
rotation_restrictions: Needs dry harvest weather to prevent pod staining.

red_kidney_bean.name: Dark Red Kidney Bean (Rajma)
red_kidney_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Large kidney-shaped beans; prized for curries and chili; contains phytohemagglutinin requiring thorough cooking.
rotation_restrictions: Poor nodulation with native rhizobia in northern plains; inoculate with Rhizobium phaseoli.

cannellini_bean.name: Cannellini Bean (White Kidney)
cannellini_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Creamy Italian heirloom dry bean; staple of Tuscan minestrone.
rotation_restrictions: Do not over-irrigate during bloom.

great_northern_bean.name: Great Northern Bean
great_northern_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Medium-sized white bean holding delicate shape; popular in French cassoulet.
rotation_restrictions: Rotate with corn or sugar beet.

cranberry_borlotti_bean.name: Cranberry / Borlotti Bean
cranberry_borlotti_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Hazelnut-like flavor; distinctive burgundy speckles on cream background.
rotation_restrictions: Harvest promptly once pods turn parchment brown.

flageolet_bean.name: Flageolet Bean
flageolet_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Tender pale green seeds harvested just before full maturity; delicate French gourmet legume.
rotation_restrictions: Needs gentle handling during threshing.

tepary_bean.name: Tepary Bean
tepary_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Supreme drought and heat tolerance (>40C); native to Sonoran desert; high protein (24%).
rotation_restrictions: Avoid fertile over-fertilized soils which induce excess vegetative vine growth instead of pods.

runner_bean.name: Scarlet Runner Bean
runner_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Perennial vine grown as annual; scarlet flowers attract pollinators; large mottled purple seeds.
rotation_restrictions: Requires trellising support; drops flowers above 30C.

lima_bean.name: Lima Bean (Butter Bean)
lima_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Flat buttery seeds; rich in dietary fiber and molybdenum; thrives in warm humid climates.
rotation_restrictions: Pole types require trellising; bush types suited for mechanized combine harvest.

moth_bean.name: Moth Bean (Matki)
moth_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Most drought-hardy legume in India; primary ingredient in Bikaneri Bhujia; carpet-forming soil cover.
rotation_restrictions: Unrivaled soil binder for sand dunes in Rajasthan and arid belts.

adzuki_bean.name: Adzuki Bean (Red Chana)
adzuki_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Sweet nutty red legume used across East Asia for sweet red bean paste (anko).
rotation_restrictions: Sensitive to saline and alkaline soils.

rice_bean.name: Rice Bean
rice_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Remarkable resistance to bruchid storage weevils and foliar fungal diseases; underutilized super-pulse.
rotation_restrictions: Thrives on acidic hillside soils with minimal inputs.

faba_bean_broad.name: Broad Bean (Bakla)
faba_bean_broad.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Massive biological nitrogen fixation (up to 160 kg N/ha); large culinary pods; cold tolerant down to -4C.
rotation_restrictions: Sensitive to heat waves during flowering; sow early rabi.

faba_bean_horse.name: Horse Bean (Field Faba Bean)
faba_bean_horse.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: High protein livestock feed grain; essential nitrogen builder in European crop rotations.
rotation_restrictions: Maintain 4-5 year break to control soil-borne stem nematodes.

white_lupin.name: White Lupin
white_lupin.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Huge protein content (38-42%); cluster roots (proteoid roots) solubilize rock phosphorus.
rotation_restrictions: Intolerant of calcareous or alkaline soils (induces severe iron chlorosis).

blue_lupin.name: Narrow-Leaf Blue Lupin
blue_lupin.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Core pulse crop in Western Australian wheatbelt; thrives on infertile deep sands.
rotation_restrictions: Rotate systematically with wheat to exploit fixed nitrogen.

tarwi_lupin.name: Tarwi (Andean Lupin / Chocho)
tarwi_lupin.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Highest oil (18-22%) and protein (44-50%) combination among all pulses; debittered by soaking.
rotation_restrictions: Heavy biomass restores organic carbon in depleted mountain soils.

bambara_groundnut.name: Bambara Groundnut
bambara_groundnut.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Pods develop subterraneanly like peanuts; thrives on barren soils where common beans and peanuts abort pods.
rotation_restrictions: Excellent companion crop intercropped with pearl millet or sorghum.

winged_bean.name: Winged Bean (Goa Bean)
winged_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Every part of plant is edible (shoots, flowers, pods, seeds, and protein-rich tubers).
rotation_restrictions: Requires trellising for high pod yield.

hyacinth_bean.name: Hyacinth Bean (Lablab / Sem)
hyacinth_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database
limitations: Multi-purpose pulse, vegetable and fodder; vigorous deep taproot extracts subsoil water.

velvet_bean.name: Velvet Bean (Mucuna)
velvet_bean.data_source: FAO Ecocrop / USDA ARS / CGIAR Global Crop Database

sunn_hemp_cover.name: Sunn Hemp Green Manure

dhaincha_green_manure.name: Dhaincha Green Manure

alfalfa_hay.name: Alfalfa / Lucerne (Queen of Forages)

red_clover.name: Red Clover

crimson_clover.name: Crimson Clover

berseem_clover.name: Berseem / Egyptian Clover

birdsfoot_trefoil.name: Birdsfoot Trefoil
